stemMarkdown: In a class, 22 boys have an average score of 56 and 23 girls have an average score of 45. What is the average score of the whole class? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total score $= 22 \times 56 + 23 \times 45 = 2267$ across $45$ students, so the average is $\dfrac{2267}{45} = 50.38$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The combined average must lie between 45 and 56, closer to whichever group is larger — a useful sanity check before computing.
